title: Photosystem II
source: The oxygen-evolving complex is the site of water oxidation. It is a metallo-oxo cluster comprising four manganese ions (in oxidation states ranging from +3 to +4) and one divalent calcium ion. When it oxidizes water, producing oxygen gas and protons, it sequentially delivers the four electrons from water to a tyrosine (D1-Y161) sidechain and then to P680 itself. It is composed of three protein subunits, OEE1 (PsbO), OEE2 (PsbP) and OEE3 (PsbQ); a fourth PsbR peptide is associated nearby.
translation: 放氧复合体是水氧化的场所。它是一个金属氧簇，包含四个锰离子（氧化态介于+3至+4之间）和一个二价钙离子。在氧化水并产生氧气和质子的过程中，它将来自水的四个电子依次传递到酪氨酸（D1-Y161）侧链，然后再传递给P680本身。该复合体由三个蛋白质亚基组成：OEE1（PsbO）、OEE2（PsbP）和OEE3（PsbQ）；另有一个PsbR肽段与其邻近结合。
